bugs.title: Gradients are summed instead of averaged when using gradient accumulation steps with pipeline parallelism
bugs.root_cause: PipelineEngine 禁用了 loss_scale_by_gas 但没有补偿性的梯度平均逻辑，导致梯度累积时梯度被求和而非平均，梯度范数与累积步数成正比
bugs.detection_method: 梯度范数与 gradient_accumulation_steps 成正比；不同 GAS 配置下相同 effective batch size 产生不同梯度范数
bugs.detection_signal: 梯度范数与 gradient_accumulation_steps 成正比；不同 GAS 配置下相同 effective batch size 产生不同梯度范数

bugs.title: Incorrect gradient computation in ZeRO-2 with DeepSpeed >= 0.17.6
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO-2 backward pass 中梯度计算存在回归 bug，导致梯度范数显著偏低（从 4.7-6.0 降到 1.6-3.2），训练质量悄然退化
bugs.detection_method: ZeRO-2 下梯度范数相比 ZeRO-1/ZeRO-3 显著偏小
bugs.detection_signal: ZeRO-2 下梯度范数相比 ZeRO-1/ZeRO-3 显著偏小

bugs.title: Cross-partition parameters incorrectly updated when using ZeRO-1/ZeRO-2 with reduce_scatter=true and Muon optimizer
bugs.root_cause: reduce_scatter 后非 target rank 保留了未 reduce 的 local 梯度，跨 partition 边界的参数梯度在不同 rank 间不一致，Muon 正交化在错误梯度上运算
bugs.detection_method: 不同 DP rank 上跨 partition 边界参数的梯度值不一致
bugs.detection_signal: 不同 DP rank 上跨 partition 边界参数的梯度值不一致

bugs.title: DistributedAttention produces numerically incorrect results when sequence length is not divisible by world size
bugs.root_cause: SeqAllToAll 在序列长度不能被 world_size 整除时产生错误的 uneven split，输出与参考实现有 max abs diff ~0.68 的偏差
bugs.detection_method: DistributedAttention 输出与本地 attention 参考实现的 max abs diff 异常大
bugs.detection_signal: DistributedAttention 输出与本地 attention 参考实现的 max abs diff 异常大

bugs.title: DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage-3 + CPU offloaded optimizer (CPUAdam) inconsistency metadata between subgroup
bugs.root_cause: CPUAdam 的 IncrementStep 在同一 step 内多次 subgroup 调用时，std::pow 路径与乘法路径产生不同的 bias_correction2 值，导致参数更新不一致
bugs.detection_method: 同一 optimizer step 内不同 subgroup 的 bias_correction2 值不同
bugs.detection_signal: 同一 optimizer step 内不同 subgroup 的 bias_correction2 值不同

bugs.title: Integer overflow in FusedAdam silently prevents weight updates for large tensors (>= 2^31 elements)
bugs.root_cause: TensorListMetadata 的 sizes 数组使用 int32，超过 2^31 个元素的 tensor 溢出为负值，CUDA kernel 循环不执行，参数和 optimizer state 不更新
bugs.detection_method: 大 tensor 的参数在 optimizer step 后 checksum 不变；权重更新量为零
bugs.detection_signal: 大 tensor 的参数在 optimizer step 后 checksum 不变；权重更新量为零

bugs.title: Missing input validation for fp16 loss_scale accepts float('inf')
bugs.root_cause: fp16 配置的 loss_scale 接受 float('inf') 而不报错，导致梯度被 inf 缩放后悄悄变成 NaN
bugs.detection_method: loss_scale 为 inf；梯度出现 NaN 但无 validation error
bugs.detection_signal: loss_scale 为 inf；梯度出现 NaN 但无 validation error

bugs.title: DeepSpeed accuracy issue for torch.compile if activation checkpoint function not compiler disabled
bugs.root_cause: DeepSpeed 自定义 checkpoint 函数与 torch.compile 不兼容，RNG state 保存/恢复机制不匹配导致 dropout 在 forward/backward 间产生不同随机数，loss 逐步发散
bugs.detection_method: loss 随训练步数缓慢发散（40000 步后 6.09 vs 期望 5.12）；启用 torch.compile 时 loss 与不启用时不同
bugs.detection_signal: loss 随训练步数缓慢发散（40000 步后 6.09 vs 期望 5.12）；启用 torch.compile 时 loss 与不启用时不同

bugs.title: ZeRO Stage 3 Overwrites Module ID Attribute Causing Incorrect Expert Placement on GPUs
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO-3 的 _register_hooks_recursively 使用通用 .id 属性覆盖用户自定义的 expert ID，导致 MoE expert 到 GPU 的映射关系被破坏
bugs.detection_method: MoE expert 的 module.id 值在 deepspeed.initialize() 后改变；expert 到 GPU 的放置逻辑错误
bugs.detection_signal: MoE expert 的 module.id 值在 deepspeed.initialize() 后改变；expert 到 GPU 的放置逻辑错误

bugs.title: Fix ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offloaded gradient loss with multiple backward() per step
bugs.root_cause: ga_steps > 1 条件阻止了 ga_steps=1 但有多次 backward 场景的梯度累积，中间 backward 的梯度被丢弃，参数偏差达 2e-3
bugs.detection_method: CPU offload 时参数值与非 offload 参考实现有 ~2x learning_rate 量级的偏差
bugs.detection_signal: CPU offload 时参数值与非 offload 参考实现有 ~2x learning_rate 量级的偏差

bugs.title: Fix zero 1 and 2 CPU-offloaded gradient norm
bugs.root_cause: CPU offload 场景下 micro_step_id > 0 的梯度被丢弃而非累积到 CPU，导致梯度范数在首个 microstep 后冻结，严重低估真实梯度幅度
bugs.detection_method: gradient_accumulation_steps > 1 时梯度范数不随 microstep 增长
bugs.detection_signal: gradient_accumulation_steps > 1 时梯度范数不随 microstep 增长

bugs.title: Fix bf16 gradient norm divergence with ZeRO stage 0
bugs.root_cause: 两个独立 bug：(1) FP16_UnfusedOptimizer 对 bf16 tensor 使用 dynamic loss scale=65536 但 backward 时未缩放 loss，梯度被除以 65536 导致灾难性缩小；(2) 非 ZeRO bf16 模式下梯度清零被跳过，梯度无限累积
bugs.detection_method: bf16+ZeRO0 时梯度范数持续增长不归零；loss scale 与 bf16 不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: bf16+ZeRO0 时梯度范数持续增长不归零；loss scale 与 bf16 不匹配

bugs.title: Fix: Update grad norm calculation for CPU offload
bugs.root_cause: CPU offload 下 gradient clipping 后 norm_for_param_grads 数据结构未更新，导致记录的梯度范数与实际 clipped 梯度不一致，梯度裁剪效果失效
bugs.detection_method: CPU offload 时 gradient clipping 后记录的 grad_norm 与实际梯度值不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: CPU offload 时 gradient clipping 后记录的 grad_norm 与实际梯度值不匹配

bugs.title: Fix gradient accumulation for Z2+offload
bugs.root_cause: micro_step_id 初始化不一致（构造函数 0 vs backward -1），导致梯度复制/累积条件判断错误，非累积边界时也执行梯度复制而非累积
bugs.detection_method: ZeRO-2+offload 下梯度值在 micro step 边界处不连续；梯度范数模式与非 offload 不同
bugs.detection_signal: ZeRO-2+offload 下梯度值在 micro step 边界处不连续；梯度范数模式与非 offload 不同

bugs.title: Bug fix for the 'Link bit16 and fp32 parameters in partition'
bugs.root_cause: link_all_hp_params 使用全局 DP world_size 而非每个 param group 各自的 world_size，导致 MoE EP 场景下 partition size 计算错误，部分参数的 _hp_mapping 为 None
bugs.detection_method: MoE 参数的 _hp_mapping 为 None；保存 optimizer state 时崩溃
bugs.detection_signal: MoE 参数的 _hp_mapping 为 None；保存 optimizer state 时崩溃

bugs.title: Support bf16_optimizer moe expert parallel training and moe EP grad_scale/grad_norm fix
bugs.root_cause: bf16 optimizer 对 MoE EP 参数使用了错误的 DP group 进行 partition 和 allreduce，且梯度范数缩放因子差了 ep_size 倍
bugs.detection_method: MoE expert 参数在不同 EP group 间不正确同步；梯度范数与预期差 ep_size 倍
bugs.detection_signal: MoE expert 参数在不同 EP group 间不正确同步；梯度范数与预期差 ep_size 倍

bugs.title: Fix wrong idx bug in invertible LayerNormBackward1
bugs.root_cause: LayerNormBackward1 CUDA kernel 中 gamma/beta 数组访问时用了 pos (threadIdx.y) 而非 idx (threadIdx.x)，导致 gamma 梯度计算使用了错误的索引
bugs.detection_method: LayerNorm backward 的 gamma 梯度与参考实现 checksum 不同
bugs.detection_signal: LayerNorm backward 的 gamma 梯度与参考实现 checksum 不同

bugs.title: Fix sort of zero checkpoint files
bugs.root_cause: checkpoint 转换工具按字母顺序排序分片文件（10, 11, 9 而非 9, 10, 11），导致 optimizer state 碎片合并顺序错误，checkpoint 数据静默损坏
bugs.detection_method: universal checkpoint 转换后 optimizer state 的 checksum 与原始不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: universal checkpoint 转换后 optimizer state 的 checksum 与原始不匹配

bugs.title: Fix Adam subgroup inconsistency
bugs.root_cause: CPUAdam 的 IncrementStep 在同一逻辑 step 的多次 subgroup 调用中混合了乘法和重计算路径，产生非 bit-identical 的 bias-correction metadata
bugs.detection_method: 同一 step 不同 subgroup 的 Adam bias correction 值不一致
bugs.detection_signal: 同一 step 不同 subgroup 的 Adam bias correction 值不一致

bugs.title: Fix that ds_secondary_tensor may be dirty when loading the model or zero checkpoint for zero++
bugs.root_cause: GatheredParameters 退出后和 checkpoint 加载后 ds_secondary_tensor 未同步更新，后续 allgather 使用了过时的缓存数据，初始训练步 loss 异常偏高
bugs.detection_method: checkpoint resume 后初始 loss 异常高；ds_secondary_tensor 与 ds_tensor 的 checksum 不一致
bugs.detection_signal: checkpoint resume 后初始 loss 异常高；ds_secondary_tensor 与 ds_tensor 的 checksum 不一致

bugs.title: Fix allreduce for BF16 and ZeRO0
bugs.root_cause: BF16_Optimizer 在 FP32 buffer 上累积梯度，但 engine 对 BF16 梯度执行 allreduce 而非 FP32 buffer，导致 reduce 的精度错误
bugs.detection_method: BF16+ZeRO0 下 allreduce 操作的 tensor dtype 与 optimizer 累积 buffer dtype 不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: BF16+ZeRO0 下 allreduce 操作的 tensor dtype 与 optimizer 累积 buffer dtype 不匹配

bugs.title: Make z3 respect comm dtype
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO-3 忽略用户配置的通信 dtype，all-gather/reduce-scatter 使用错误的精度类型进行参数/梯度通信
bugs.detection_method: ZeRO-3 通信操作的 tensor dtype 与配置的 communication_data_type 不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: ZeRO-3 通信操作的 tensor dtype 与配置的 communication_data_type 不匹配

bugs.title: ZeRO Stage 2 seems to train MoE models incorrectly
bugs.root_cause: MoE gate 参数（deepspeed_moe.gate.wg）未被 ZeRO-2 的梯度 hook 捕获，gate 梯度从不参与 reduce，导致 gate 权重训练错误
bugs.detection_method: MoE gate 参数的 gradient 在 backward hook 中缺失；gate 参数不在 reduce_and_remove_grad_hooks 的 tracked 列表中
bugs.detection_signal: MoE gate 参数的 gradient 在 backward hook 中缺失；gate 参数不在 reduce_and_remove_grad_hooks 的 tracked 列表中

bugs.title: Fixed the problem of loading universal checkpoint error in multi-machine mode
bugs.root_cause: 多机环境下 stage3 universal checkpoint 加载逻辑存在 bug，导致加载后 loss 异常升高而非从断点恢复
bugs.detection_method: checkpoint resume 后 loss 异常升高而非从保存点继续
bugs.detection_signal: checkpoint resume 后 loss 异常升高而非从保存点继续

bugs.title: Fix checkpointing/loading of z0+bf16
bugs.root_cause: bf16+ZeRO0 时配置标志错误导致 optimizer 的 step counter、exp_avg、exp_avg_sq 等状态在 checkpoint 加载后丢失
bugs.detection_method: checkpoint resume 后 optimizer state 的 step counter 重置为 0；exp_avg/exp_avg_sq 为全零
bugs.detection_signal: checkpoint resume 后 optimizer state 的 step counter 重置为 0；exp_avg/exp_avg_sq 为全零

bugs.title: Fix the sequence-parallelism for the dense model architecture
bugs.root_cause: 序列并行下梯度被全局 world_size 错误缩放（应该是 SP rank 间求和后 DP group 内取平均），且 SP reduce 在 BF16 下执行导致精度损失，梯度范数持续增长
bugs.detection_method: SP=2 时梯度范数显著低于 SP=1；梯度范数随训练步数持续增长
bugs.detection_signal: SP=2 时梯度范数显著低于 SP=1；梯度范数随训练步数持续增长

bugs.title: ZeRO3: Gradient norm allreduce for DP
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO-3 的 gradient norm 在 DP 训练中未正确 allreduce，导致 ZeRO 0/1/2/3 产生不同的训练结果
bugs.detection_method: ZeRO-3 的 gradient norm 与 ZeRO-0/1/2 不一致
bugs.detection_signal: ZeRO-3 的 gradient norm 与 ZeRO-0/1/2 不一致

bugs.title: bf16_optimizer: fixes to different grad acc dtype
bugs.root_cause: bf16 optimizer 的 step 函数在 gradient accumulation dtype 与 model dtype 不同时未正确转换梯度到 FP32，导致数值不准确
bugs.detection_method: bf16 + FP32 grad_accum 时 optimizer step 中梯度 dtype 与预期不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: bf16 + FP32 grad_accum 时 optimizer step 中梯度 dtype 与预期不匹配

bugs.title: MOE gate fixes and enhancements
bugs.root_cause: 三个 bug：(1) gate capacity 未按 TP 对齐导致 token drop 时 crash；(2) gate 线性层在 forward 中被转成 fp32 但参数是 ZeRO flat buffer 的 view，破坏了参数管理；(3) top-2 aux loss 公式多乘了 num_experts
bugs.detection_method: gate 参数 dtype 在 forward 后被修改；top-2 aux loss 与 top-1 不成比例
bugs.detection_signal: gate 参数 dtype 在 forward 后被修改；top-2 aux loss 与 top-1 不成比例

bugs.title: reduce_bucket_size influences training convergence of Zero2
bugs.root_cause: reduce_bucket_size 本应仅影响通信效率，但实际影响了训练收敛：不同 bucket size 导致显著不同的 loss 曲线，极小值会导致 NaN
bugs.detection_method: 仅改变 reduce_bucket_size 即导致 loss 曲线显著变化
bugs.detection_signal: 仅改变 reduce_bucket_size 即导致 loss 曲线显著变化

bugs.title: Checkpoint global_step number inconsistent with checkpoint step number
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO-3 训练后期 checkpoint 目录名与内部 global_step 不一致（如 checkpoint-800 包含 global_step799），差距随训练扩大
bugs.detection_method: checkpoint 目录名中的 step 与内部 global_step 文件记录的值不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: checkpoint 目录名中的 step 与内部 global_step 文件记录的值不匹配

bugs.title: Fix all-gather duplicate params and wrong dtype
bugs.root_cause: PyTorch autocast 下同一 coalesced all-gather 中多个操作共享含混合 dtype 参数的列表，导致参数状态追踪错乱（expected AVAILABLE got inflight）
bugs.detection_method: ZeRO-3 参数状态 tracking 在 autocast 下出现不一致；all-gather 中参数 dtype 混合
bugs.detection_signal: ZeRO-3 参数状态 tracking 在 autocast 下出现不一致；all-gather 中参数 dtype 混合

bugs.title: Fix saving and loading model checkpoint logic for MiCS sharding
bugs.root_cause: MiCS 只有第一个 partition group 保存 checkpoint，其他 group 的数据丢失；加载时也缺少对 MiCS partition 的支持
bugs.detection_method: MiCS checkpoint 文件缺少非第一 partition group 的数据
bugs.detection_signal: MiCS checkpoint 文件缺少非第一 partition group 的数据

bugs.title: Fix the universal checkpoint issue for stage3 with multiple subgroups
bugs.root_cause: stage3 universal checkpoint 未正确处理多 subgroup 场景，tensor slicing 越界；多进程同时写入同一 checkpoint 文件导致竞争条件和数据损坏
bugs.detection_method: universal checkpoint 转换时 tensor 访问越界；多进程写入同一文件导致 checksum 不稳定
bugs.detection_signal: universal checkpoint 转换时 tensor 访问越界；多进程写入同一文件导致 checksum 不稳定

bugs.title: ZeRO Gradient Accumulation Dtype
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO 各 stage 强制梯度累积使用与模型权重相同的 dtype，BF16 训练时梯度在 BF16 精度下累积导致数值不稳定
bugs.detection_method: BF16 模型的 grad_accum buffer dtype 不是 FP32；梯度累积后精度损失可检测
bugs.detection_signal: BF16 模型的 grad_accum buffer dtype 不是 FP32；梯度累积后精度损失可检测

bugs.title: MOE: Fix save checkpoint when TP > 1
bugs.root_cause: MoE checkpoint 保存仅保留 rank 0 的 model_states 文件，TP > 1 时其他 TP rank 的数据缺失
bugs.detection_method: TP > 1 时 checkpoint 目录中仅有 mp_rank_00_model_states.pt，缺少其他 TP rank 文件
bugs.detection_signal: TP > 1 时 checkpoint 目录中仅有 mp_rank_00_model_states.pt，缺少其他 TP rank 文件

bugs.title: Wrong embedding gradients with distributed optimizer and shared embedding
bugs.root_cause: When use_distributed_optimizer + share_embeddings_and_output_weights, embedding gradients are reduce-scattered across DP ranks before being all-reduced across PP stages, causing partial results to be summed incorrectly. wte and lm_head grads end up on different DP ranks, producing wrong embedding gradients.
bugs.detection_method: Embedding gradient checksum differs across PP[0] and PP[-1] within the same DP group after finalize_model_grads
bugs.detection_signal: Embedding gradient checksum differs across PP[0] and PP[-1] within the same DP group after finalize_model_grads

bugs.title: Wrong attention gradient when Context Parallelism is on
bugs.root_cause: dQ, dK, dV output from the backward function of core_attention are wrong when context parallelism is enabled. Activation gradients have relative error as large as 1.2 compared to single-card training.
bugs.detection_method: Attention gradient norm/checksum deviates significantly from single-GPU reference; relative error > 1.0 in dQ/dK/dV
bugs.detection_signal: Attention gradient norm/checksum deviates significantly from single-GPU reference; relative error > 1.0 in dQ/dK/dV

bugs.title: Incorrect loss scaling in context parallel code logic
bugs.root_cause: Loss is multiplied by cp_size in the backward pass, causing gradient outputs to differ from non-CP training. The mul cp_size logic should be removed; gradients should use the chunk's local loss, not the all-reduced loss.
bugs.detection_method: Gradient values are scaled by cp_size factor compared to baseline; loss*cp_size introduces incorrect scaling
bugs.detection_signal: Gradient values are scaled by cp_size factor compared to baseline; loss*cp_size introduces incorrect scaling

bugs.title: MTP loss in multi-token prediction not averaged causing gradient explosion
bugs.root_cause: When mtp_loss is a tensor and calculate_per_token_loss is set, failing to divide by num_tokens results in mtp_loss.sum().backward() instead of per-token averaging, causing gradient explosion and incorrect training.
bugs.detection_method: MTP loss value abnormally large; gradient norm spikes due to un-normalized loss
bugs.detection_signal: MTP loss value abnormally large; gradient norm spikes due to un-normalized loss

bugs.title: Tensor parallelism produces divergent loss with non-divisible vocabulary sizes
bugs.root_cause: When vocabulary size is not evenly divisible by TP size, uneven vocab splits cause systematic loss divergence. After 2000 steps, absolute error reaches 47.137 (>50% relative error) vs single-GPU training.
bugs.detection_method: Loss value diverges significantly from single-GPU baseline when vocab_size % tp_size != 0
bugs.detection_signal: Loss value diverges significantly from single-GPU baseline when vocab_size % tp_size != 0

bugs.title: Stale weights used with --overlap-param-gather when bucket order differs from forward order
bugs.root_cause: When parameter bucket order differs from model forward execution order, all-gather hasn't completed for a bucket before its parameters are used in forward. The previous step's weights are used, producing incorrect results.
bugs.detection_method: Parameter checksum on some ranks matches the previous iteration's value instead of the current one during forward pass
bugs.detection_signal: Parameter checksum on some ranks matches the previous iteration's value instead of the current one during forward pass

bugs.title: Sequence parallel not all-gathered when using Flash Attention
bugs.root_cause: With sequence parallelism and Flash Attention, q/k/v tensors are not all-gathered before flash attention. Attention is computed only on L/sp_size chunk instead of full sequence, causing model to stop attending to previous content beyond the chunk boundary.
bugs.detection_method: Attention output differs from non-SP reference; model attends only within local chunk, not full sequence
bugs.detection_signal: Attention output differs from non-SP reference; model attends only within local chunk, not full sequence

bugs.title: RoPE ignores position IDs with --reset-position-ids
bugs.root_cause: When --reset-position-ids is used, RoPE always uses positions 0 to seq_len-1 instead of the actual position IDs. Rotary embeddings do not account for enc_position_ids, producing incorrect positional encodings.
bugs.detection_method: RoPE embedding values are identical regardless of actual position IDs; position 0-N used even when reset is active
bugs.detection_signal: RoPE embedding values are identical regardless of actual position IDs; position 0-N used even when reset is active

bugs.title: seq_aux_loss + pad_to_capacity produces corrupted routing map and wrong load balancing loss
bugs.root_cause: When pad_to_capacity is enabled, dummy padded tokens corrupt the routing_map used for load-balancing loss computation. The auxiliary loss becomes constantly 1.0 instead of reflecting true token distribution across experts.
bugs.detection_method: Auxiliary load balancing loss is constant 1.0; routing_map includes padded tokens with zero probabilities
bugs.detection_signal: Auxiliary load balancing loss is constant 1.0; routing_map includes padded tokens with zero probabilities

bugs.title: Learning rate not overridden when set --override-opt_param-scheduler
bugs.root_cause: When loading a checkpoint with --override-opt_param-scheduler and new LR params, the get_lr method still retrieves max_lr/min_lr from param_group (old values), ignoring the override. LR scheduler state persists incorrectly.
bugs.detection_method: Learning rate value matches old checkpoint values instead of new override values after resume
bugs.detection_signal: Learning rate value matches old checkpoint values instead of new override values after resume

bugs.title: Optimizer offload checkpoint loading causes loss to jump from 0.31 to 10
bugs.root_cause: With --use-precision-aware-optimizer and --optimizer-cpu-offload, resuming from checkpoint causes loss to jump dramatically (0.31 -> 10). Optimizer state is corrupted during serialization/deserialization with CPU offloading active.
bugs.detection_method: Loss value jumps dramatically after checkpoint resume with optimizer offload enabled
bugs.detection_signal: Loss value jumps dramatically after checkpoint resume with optimizer offload enabled

bugs.title: mcore-0.12.0 checkpoint resume produces significantly different loss values
bugs.root_cause: Checkpoint resume in mcore-0.12 cannot reproduce the same loss in the first forward pass, with large loss deviation compared to v0.11. Likely caused by optimizer state or RNG state not being fully restored.
bugs.detection_method: Loss value immediately after checkpoint resume differs significantly from pre-save value
bugs.detection_signal: Loss value immediately after checkpoint resume differs significantly from pre-save value

bugs.title: Mismatch between docstring and behavior in model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed
bugs.root_cause: Docstring claims RNG states should be same across DP groups but different across MP groups. Actual behavior: data_parallel_seed is the same for all ranks, but the tensor_model_parallel_seed derivation may not match documentation, causing incorrect dropout behavior.
bugs.detection_method: RNG states are not consistent across DP ranks when they should be, causing different dropout masks
bugs.detection_signal: RNG states are not consistent across DP ranks when they should be, causing different dropout masks

bugs.title: finish_embedding_wgrad_compute appears after grad all-reduce
bugs.root_cause: In pipeline parallel schedules, embedding weight gradient computation finishes after gradient all-reduce has already occurred. This means the all-reduced gradient does not include the final embedding wgrad contribution.
bugs.detection_method: Embedding gradient after all-reduce is incomplete; gradient computed after sync point is not included
bugs.detection_signal: Embedding gradient after all-reduce is incomplete; gradient computed after sync point is not included

bugs.title: Incorrect softmax_factor in MLA using mscale instead of mscale_all_dim
bugs.root_cause: Multi-Head Latent Attention uses wrong scaling variable (mscale vs mscale_all_dim) for softmax_factor calculation. No error is thrown but attention scaling is mathematically incorrect, diverging from DeepSeek-V3 reference.
bugs.detection_method: Softmax scale factor value differs from reference implementation; attention output diverges
bugs.detection_signal: Softmax scale factor value differs from reference implementation; attention output diverges

bugs.title: Fix error in pipeline-parallel schedules to support context parallel
bugs.root_cause: get_tensor_shapes() in schedules.py doesn't account for context parallel size, producing wrong tensor shapes for p2p communication between pipeline stages when CP is enabled.
bugs.detection_method: Tensor shapes in pipeline p2p communication don't match actual activation shapes with CP enabled
bugs.detection_signal: Tensor shapes in pipeline p2p communication don't match actual activation shapes with CP enabled

bugs.title: Fix: Initialize master_weight with params_dtype directly
bugs.root_cause: Master weights are initialized by first creating in one dtype then casting, instead of directly using params_dtype. The unnecessary casting introduces numerical precision loss during initialization, affecting mixed-precision training.
bugs.detection_method: Master weight values differ slightly from direct initialization due to unnecessary dtype casting
bugs.detection_signal: Master weight values differ slightly from direct initialization due to unnecessary dtype casting

bugs.title: Multi-stream sync problem in model init causes DDP to read uninitialized parameters
bugs.root_cause: DDP initialization runs in a separate CUDA stream from parameter initialization. Without proper synchronization, DDP copies parameter values into buckets before initialization completes, capturing garbage or partially-initialized data.
bugs.detection_method: DDP bucket parameter checksums don't match source parameter checksums at initialization; uninitialized values in DDP buffers
bugs.detection_signal: DDP bucket parameter checksums don't match source parameter checksums at initialization; uninitialized values in DDP buffers

bugs.title: Fix data helpers overflow bug (int32 overflow in sample_idx)
bugs.root_cause: doc_idx_index (int64) is assigned to sample_idx (int32). When doc_idx_index exceeds int32 range during long training with short-sentence datasets, silent integer overflow produces wrong data indices, feeding incorrect training samples.
bugs.detection_method: sample_idx wraps around due to int32 overflow; wrong documents/samples are loaded for training
bugs.detection_signal: sample_idx wraps around due to int32 overflow; wrong documents/samples are loaded for training

bugs.title: Correctness concern for RoPE in context parallel - position embedding split logic
bugs.root_cause: RoPE position embedding split logic for context parallel may not correctly assign sine/cosine values to each CP rank. The reshaping of embeddings by sequence length doesn't properly account for the distributed sequence chunks.
bugs.detection_method: RoPE embedding values on different CP ranks don't correspond to correct sequence positions
bugs.detection_signal: RoPE embedding values on different CP ranks don't correspond to correct sequence positions

bugs.title: torch.compile recompile limit breaks autograd graph in PPO loop, silently incorrect gradients
bugs.root_cause: In PPO training loops, requires_grad state switching causes torch.compile to hit recompile limit. This breaks the autograd graph, and c10d::broadcast_ without registered autograd kernel leads to silently incorrect gradients.
bugs.detection_method: Gradient values are incorrect after torch.compile recompile limit is hit; broadcast_ operations not tracked in autograd
bugs.detection_signal: Gradient values are incorrect after torch.compile recompile limit is hit; broadcast_ operations not tracked in autograd

bugs.title: Learning rate error when continuing training - first step uses old LR value
bugs.root_cause: After loading checkpoint with --override-opt_param-scheduler and new LR setting, the first training step still uses the old learning rate from the checkpoint instead of the new configured value.
bugs.detection_method: Learning rate at first resumed step matches old checkpoint LR instead of newly configured value
bugs.detection_signal: Learning rate at first resumed step matches old checkpoint LR instead of newly configured value

bugs.title: MXFP8 params without DP comm overlap causes NaN loss
bugs.root_cause: Using --fp8-param-gather and --reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag without --overlap-grad-reduce and --overlap-param-gather causes gradient buffer corruption leading to NaN. The gradient buffer reuse conflicts with non-overlapped communication.
bugs.detection_method: Loss becomes NaN; gradient buffer values corrupted due to premature reuse before communication completes
bugs.detection_signal: Loss becomes NaN; gradient buffer values corrupted due to premature reuse before communication completes

bugs.title: Loss error when using Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)
bugs.root_cause: MLA implementation produces unexpected loss values with megatron-core 0.10.0. Training proceeds without errors but produces abnormal loss patterns, indicating incorrect attention computation.
bugs.detection_method: Loss values are abnormal compared to non-MLA reference; attention output may be numerically incorrect
bugs.detection_signal: Loss values are abnormal compared to non-MLA reference; attention output may be numerically incorrect

bugs.title: Gradient synchronization incorrect when --overlap-grad-reduce and --num-distributed-optimizer-instances > 1
bugs.root_cause: DDP post-hook executes on a side CUDA stream due to expand_as inheriting stream affinity, causing reduce-scatter to launch before hook completion and producing silently incorrect gradient values.
bugs.detection_method: Gradient checksum differs across DP ranks after reduce-scatter due to stream synchronization race
bugs.detection_signal: Gradient checksum differs across DP ranks after reduce-scatter due to stream synchronization race

bugs.title: [BUG] Wrong attention gradient in Transformer Engine
bugs.root_cause: Fused attention backward pass (fused_attn_bwd) produces dQ with relative error >1.0 for deep models, silently corrupting gradients when using TE fused attention with TP.
bugs.detection_method: Attention gradient relative error exceeds 1.0 compared to non-fused reference; grad_norm abnormally large
bugs.detection_signal: Attention gradient relative error exceeds 1.0 compared to non-fused reference; grad_norm abnormally large

bugs.title: [Bug]: Attention Mask Ignored in transformer_engine Backend with Packed Sequences
bugs.root_cause: TE layer defaults to attn_mask_type='causal' and silently ignores the block-diagonal attention_mask, causing cross-document attention leakage during packed-sequence training.
bugs.detection_method: Attention output with packed sequences differs from expected block-diagonal masked output; cross-document attention leakage
bugs.detection_signal: Attention output with packed sequences differs from expected block-diagonal masked output; cross-document attention leakage

bugs.title: Possible RoPE frequency format mismatch in MultiLatentAttention when rotary_interleaved=True
bugs.root_cause: YarnRotaryEmbedding is instantiated without forwarding rotary_interleaved from config, generating half-half layout frequencies applied with interleaved logic, silently corrupting positional encodings.
bugs.detection_method: RoPE embedding values differ from expected when rotary_interleaved=True; positional encoding corrupted
bugs.detection_signal: RoPE embedding values differ from expected when rotary_interleaved=True; positional encoding corrupted

bugs.title: MTPLossAutoScaler loss scale bugs when cp enabled
bugs.root_cause: When CP is enabled num_microbatches is multiplied by cp_size in pipeline scheduling, but MTPLossAutoScaler does not compensate, silently under-scaling MTP loss gradients by the CP factor.
bugs.detection_method: MTP loss gradient is scaled down by cp_size factor compared to expected; loss_scale incorrect with CP
bugs.detection_signal: MTP loss gradient is scaled down by cp_size factor compared to expected; loss_scale incorrect with CP

bugs.title: fix(moe): fix the bug where gate was not sliced when kv_head < tp_size
bugs.root_cause: MoE gate tensor is not partitioned across TP ranks when kv_head < tp_size, causing all TP ranks to use the full gate instead of their slice, silently producing incorrect routing decisions.
bugs.detection_method: Gate weight shape is identical across TP ranks when it should be sliced; routing decisions incorrect
bugs.detection_signal: Gate weight shape is identical across TP ranks when it should be sliced; routing decisions incorrect

bugs.title: Fix bug of reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag
bugs.root_cause: When forward_pre_hook is disabled, finish_param_sync() is never called to zero the gradient buffer on the first iteration, so initial parameter values pollute the main gradients silently.
bugs.detection_method: Gradient buffer contains non-zero values before first backward; grad_norm abnormally large on first iteration
bugs.detection_signal: Gradient buffer contains non-zero values before first backward; grad_norm abnormally large on first iteration

bugs.title: bug fix: when eval, dropout_p turns to 0 forever
bugs.root_cause: FlashSelfAttention permanently sets dropout_p to 0 during eval mode and never restores it, silently disabling dropout in all subsequent training steps after the first evaluation.
bugs.detection_method: After eval step, activation statistics change (lower variance) indicating dropout is disabled; cksum pattern shifts
bugs.detection_signal: After eval step, activation statistics change (lower variance) indicating dropout is disabled; cksum pattern shifts

bugs.title: Optimizer state is empty when save-interval=20
bugs.root_cause: When saving checkpoint at iteration 20 with save-interval=20, optimizer state dict is missing 'exp_avg' key. The optimizer state hasn't been properly populated at early save points, leading to corrupt checkpoints.
bugs.detection_method: Checkpoint optimizer state is missing exp_avg/exp_avg_sq; KeyError on resume
bugs.detection_signal: Checkpoint optimizer state is missing exp_avg/exp_avg_sq; KeyError on resume

bugs.title: Sequential OLMo block should not have shared layernorm
bugs.root_cause: Sequential transformer block 中 attention 和 FFN 路径共享了同一个 LayerNorm（self.norm），而 FFN 路径应该使用 self.norm2，导致两路归一化参数耦合
bugs.detection_method: FFN 路径和 attention 路径的 LayerNorm 输出完全相同（应该不同）；模型训练效果不佳但不会 crash
bugs.detection_signal: FFN 路径和 attention 路径的 LayerNorm 输出完全相同（应该不同）；模型训练效果不佳但不会 crash

bugs.title: FSDP reduce_dtype=bfloat16 causes output logit norm growth at scale (>4 nodes)
bugs.root_cause: FSDP mixed precision 中 reduce_dtype=bfloat16 在多节点（>4 nodes）训练时导致 output logit norm 持续增长，最终导致 PPL 指标出现 Inf，但 loss 仍然正常
bugs.detection_method: output logit norm 随训练步数持续线性增长；PPL 出现 Inf 但 loss 不变；问题随节点数增加而加剧
bugs.detection_signal: output logit norm 随训练步数持续线性增长；PPL 出现 Inf 但 loss 不变；问题随节点数增加而加剧

bugs.title: Changed from ignored_index to ignore_index for cross_entropy_loss (flash-attn API change)
bugs.root_cause: flash-attn >= 2.5.8 将 cross_entropy_loss 的参数名从 ignored_index 改为 ignore_index，但 OLMo 未同步更新，导致 ignore_index 参数未生效，padding token 被错误地计入 loss
bugs.detection_method: loss 值偏低（padding token 参与了 loss 计算使分母变大）；模型对 padding 位置产生了非零梯度
bugs.detection_signal: loss 值偏低（padding token 参与了 loss 计算使分母变大）；模型对 padding 位置产生了非零梯度

bugs.title: Fix bug with saving unsharded checkpoint
bugs.root_cause: 保存 unsharded checkpoint 时存在 bug，导致 checkpoint 状态不完整或不正确，从该 checkpoint 恢复训练会产生错误结果
bugs.detection_method: 从 unsharded checkpoint 恢复训练后，loss 与中断前不连续
bugs.detection_signal: 从 unsharded checkpoint 恢复训练后，loss 与中断前不连续

bugs.title: Fix CP bug with RoPE buffers: blocks reused identical RoPE buffers in context parallelism
bugs.root_cause: Context parallelism 下不同 block 复用了相同的 RoPE buffer，导致所有 block 使用相同的位置编码而非各自分片后的位置编码
bugs.detection_method: 不同 transformer block 在 CP 模式下的 RoPE buffer 完全相同（应该不同）；attention pattern 异常
bugs.detection_signal: 不同 transformer block 在 CP 模式下的 RoPE buffer 完全相同（应该不同）；attention pattern 异常

bugs.title: Fix TP with LMHead fused_linear loss: wrong distributed tensor handling for ce_loss and z_loss
bugs.root_cause: LMHead 在 tensor parallelism 下使用 fused_linear loss 时，ce_loss 和 z_loss 被错误地作为 distributed tensor 组合（应作为 local tensor），且 w_out 缺少 TP wrapper 导致 FSDP 参数分布不一致
bugs.detection_method: TP 模式下 loss 值与非 TP 模式不一致；w_out 参数仅在 DP 维度分布而其他参数在 DP+TP 维度分布
bugs.detection_signal: TP 模式下 loss 值与非 TP 模式不一致；w_out 参数仅在 DP 维度分布而其他参数在 DP+TP 维度分布

bugs.title: Removed buggy fused cross-entropy loss variant that consistently under-performed
bugs.root_cause: Fused cross-entropy loss 实现存在 bug，导致 loss 计算结果始终低于原生 PyTorch 实现（compiled 后），严重到需要 Post Incident Report 和完全移除该实现
bugs.detection_method: fused CE loss 与 native PyTorch CE loss 的计算结果不一致；训练效果持续不佳
bugs.detection_signal: fused CE loss 与 native PyTorch CE loss 的计算结果不一致；训练效果持续不佳

bugs.title: Instance mask correction to avoid NaN loss
bugs.root_cause: Instance masking 实现中存在 bug，当 batch 中所有 token 都被 mask 时导致除以零产生 NaN loss
bugs.detection_method: 特定 batch 上 loss 突然变为 NaN；与 instance mask 中的全零 mask 相关
bugs.detection_signal: 特定 batch 上 loss 突然变为 NaN；与 instance mask 中的全零 mask 相关

bugs.title: Fixed CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay scheduler initialization bug
bugs.root_cause: CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay 学习率 scheduler 的初始化逻辑错误，导致学习率 schedule 不符合预期
bugs.detection_method: 实际 learning rate schedule 与配置的 cosine+warmup+linear decay 不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: 实际 learning rate schedule 与配置的 cosine+warmup+linear decay 不匹配

bugs.title: Fixed ReorderedNormTransformerBlock with fine-grained FSDP wrapping + activation checkpointing
bugs.root_cause: ReorderedNormTransformerBlock 在同时使用 fine-grained FSDP wrapping 和 activation checkpointing 时出现交互 bug，产生不正确的计算结果
bugs.detection_method: fine-grained FSDP + activation checkpointing 组合下，forward/backward 结果与未使用时不一致
bugs.detection_signal: fine-grained FSDP + activation checkpointing 组合下，forward/backward 结果与未使用时不一致

bugs.title: Fixed LM evaluator data-order drift across repeated runs via loader bookkeeping reset
bugs.root_cause: LM evaluator 的 data loader 在重复运行间存在数据顺序漂移，因为 bookkeeping state 未被正确重置，导致不同 eval run 看到不同顺序的数据
bugs.detection_method: 相同配置下多次 evaluation 结果不一致；data loader 的内部 index 状态在 run 之间未重置
bugs.detection_signal: 相同配置下多次 evaluation 结果不一致；data loader 的内部 index 状态在 run 之间未重置

bugs.title: Source mixture datasets truncating source files instead of randomly sampling
bugs.root_cause: SourceMixtureDataset 在需要采样数据时错误地截断源文件而非随机采样，导致训练只使用了每个源文件的前 N 条数据
bugs.detection_method: 数据使用分布偏向每个源文件的开头部分；实际训练数据覆盖率低于预期
bugs.detection_signal: 数据使用分布偏向每个源文件的开头部分；实际训练数据覆盖率低于预期

bugs.title: Initialization bug in Attention/GatedDeltaNet: depth-scaled output projection init never applied
bugs.root_cause: Attention 和 GatedDeltaNet 中 depth-scaled output projection 初始化由于错误的自比较运算符（self-equality check）而从未生效，初始化使用了错误的 scale
bugs.detection_method: output projection 的初始化权重 scale 与配置的 depth-scaled init 不匹配；所有层的 output projection scale 相同（应随深度变化）
bugs.detection_signal: output projection 的初始化权重 scale 与配置的 depth-scaled init 不匹配；所有层的 output projection scale 相同（应随深度变化）

bugs.title: FSDP silently ignores state_dict loaded between forward and backward
bugs.root_cause: FSDP FULL_SHARD 策略下，在 forward 和 backward 之间调用 load_state_dict() 会被静默忽略，模型继续使用旧权重而非加载的 checkpoint 权重
bugs.detection_method: checkpoint 加载后模型输出与加载前相同（应该不同）；load_state_dict 不报错但无效果
bugs.detection_signal: checkpoint 加载后模型输出与加载前相同（应该不同）；load_state_dict 不报错但无效果

bugs.title: torch.ops.fsdp.set_ with torch.compile silently incorrect due to CSE optimization
bugs.root_cause: FSDP 的 set_ 操作未被 functionalized，torch.compile 的 CSE 优化错误地消除了 set_ 之后的重复表达式，导致静默产生错误结果
bugs.detection_method: torch.compile + FSDP 下计算结果与 eager mode 不一致；set_ 之后的操作返回了 set_ 之前的值
bugs.detection_signal: torch.compile + FSDP 下计算结果与 eager mode 不一致；set_ 之后的操作返回了 set_ 之前的值

bugs.title: FSDP full precision model.eval() silently failing with precision mismatch
bugs.root_cause: FSDP 包装的模型调用 model.eval() 时，某些参数未能正确 cast 到 full precision，F.scaled_dot_product_attention 收到了 fp32/bf16 混合输入，但不报错
bugs.detection_method: eval 模式下 attention 层的输入 dtype 不一致（应全部为 fp32）；inference 结果不正确
bugs.detection_signal: eval 模式下 attention 层的输入 dtype 不一致（应全部为 fp32）；inference 结果不正确

bugs.title: FSDP gradient accumulation outside no_sync() with CPU offloading yields incorrect results
bugs.root_cause: FSDP 在 no_sync() 外部做 gradient accumulation 且使用 CPU offloading 时，直接使用新 reduce 的梯度替代累积梯度，而非叠加
bugs.detection_method: gradient accumulation 时梯度未被正确累积；每次 accumulation step 的梯度覆盖了之前的梯度
bugs.detection_signal: gradient accumulation 时梯度未被正确累积；每次 accumulation step 的梯度覆盖了之前的梯度

bugs.title: Fix FSDP+PP stream sync bug: gradient corruption from race condition
bugs.root_cause: Pipeline parallelism 的 backward 实现为支持 zero-bubble scheduling 而直接调用 .grad() 并手动累积梯度，但遗漏了 FSDP 的 _root_post_backward_final_callback，导致 reduce-scatter 与梯度读取间的竞态条件
bugs.detection_method: FSDP+PP 模式下梯度值不确定性变化；backward 结束后梯度值与预期不一致
bugs.detection_signal: FSDP+PP 模式下梯度值不确定性变化；backward 结束后梯度值与预期不一致

bugs.title: FP32 accumulation of bf16 gradients in FSDP: training unstable at 48x8 GPU scale
bugs.root_cause: FSDP 使用 bf16 reduce_dtype 时，梯度的 accumulation/reduction 操作在 bf16 精度下进行，大规模（48x8 GPU）训练变得不稳定
bugs.detection_method: 大规模训练（>100 GPU）时 loss 不稳定或 diverge；reduce_dtype=bf16 比 reduce_dtype=fp32 时训练质量差
bugs.detection_signal: 大规模训练（>100 GPU）时 loss 不稳定或 diverge；reduce_dtype=bf16 比 reduce_dtype=fp32 时训练质量差

bugs.title: DTensor + python float numeric bug in gradient clipping: epsilon added per-rank instead of once
bugs.root_cause: Gradient clipping 中 clip_coef = max_norm / (total_norm + 1e-6) 的 1e-6 在每个 rank 上各加了一次（而非全局加一次），导致 clip coefficient 随 world size 变化
bugs.detection_method: gradient clip coefficient 随 world size 改变（应该不变）；不同 world size 下相同 gradient 被 clip 到不同值
bugs.detection_signal: gradient clip coefficient 随 world size 改变（应该不变）；不同 world size 下相同 gradient 被 clip 到不同值

bugs.title: FSDP use_orig_params + full sharding results in missing parameters in gathered state dict
bugs.root_cause: FSDP 在 use_orig_params=True + FULL_SHARD 策略下，inner module 的 state_dict 缺少部分子模块的参数，而 wrapped model 的 state_dict 包含正确的参数
bugs.detection_method: state_dict 中缺少部分参数；inner module 和 wrapped model 的 state_dict key 不一致
bugs.detection_signal: state_dict 中缺少部分参数；inner module 和 wrapped model 的 state_dict key 不一致
